purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The City has a clear public-facing cadastral viewer and a documented official WFS operation. However, the WFS is selected by section/parcel or broad township/city; no exact parcel ID or output-field allowlist was confirmed, and a township-wide query would exceed the bounded scope.
registryAssessment: The official city land bureau publishes cadastral map services and TNGIS cadastral WFS documentation. This establishes municipal cadastre services, not legal title or exact WUP point coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city service index describes SV3 as cadastral WFS geometry by parcel, section, or township/city; output may use TWD97 (EPSG:3826) or WGS84 (EPSG:4326). It also describes SV1 XY lookup, which returns sensitive ownership and title attributes and was excluded.
Official SV3 operation documentation lists QM, QD, EPSG parameters and WFS operation; examples are parcel, section, or township/city selection.
Official trial page documents modes QM=1 by SEC+NO, QM=2 by SEC, QM=3 by TOWN, and output EPSG codes 3826/4326; it does not document output-field selection.
Official city interactive map provides land/section parcel search and identifies map features; no exact WUP-point parcel ID was derived.
Taiwan open data portal describes Tainan’s digital cadastral map, section/admin attributes, and WMS services from multiple local land offices; annual dataset entry, not an exact parcel response.

serviceChecks.observation: SV3 cadastral WFS query is described by parcel, section, or township/city; EPSG:3826 or 4326 supported.
QM/QD/EPSG required. Example scopes include a single lot, one section, or a whole township/city. No unbounded query issued.
XY mode returns land ownership, land descriptors, other rights, and building ownership/registration fields; deliberately not invoked.

privacy: Did not invoke SV1 XY identification because it returns ownership/title tables. No cadastral WFS request was made without a safely scoped identifier; no geometry or owner/parcel attributes retained.
